excerpts.label: Early window
excerpts.quote: She carries on a war against the lawful commerce of a friend that she may the better carry on a commerce with an enemy ?
excerpts.title: June 1, 1812: Special Message to Congress on the Foreign Policy Crisis -- War Message
excerpts.cite: James Madison, Special Message to Congress on the Foreign Policy Crisis -- War Message, 1812

excerpts.label: Highest-supported window
excerpts.quote: I am strongly convinced that we need in this Government just such an office, and that it can be secured by making the Tariff Board already appointed a permanent tariff commission, with such duties, powers, and emoluments as it may seem wise to Congress to give.
excerpts.title: December 6, 1910: Second Annual Message
excerpts.cite: William Howard Taft, Second Annual Message, 1910

excerpts.label: Recent window
excerpts.quote: So we will work with the EU to facilitate more trade within the region, build on existing agreements to promote integration with U.S. and European markets, and open the door for those countries who adopt high standards of reform and trade liberalization to construct a regional trade arrangement.
excerpts.title: May 19, 2011: Speech on American Diplomacy in the Middle East and North Africa
excerpts.cite: Barack Obama, Speech on American Diplomacy in the Middle East and North Africa, 2011

fine_topics.name: Tariffs, Reciprocity & Navigation Laws
fine_topics.definition: Import duties and protective tariffs, reciprocal trade and navigation treaties, tonnage, and disputes over trade practices with foreign rivals.

fine_topics.name: Trusts, Corporations & Antitrust
fine_topics.definition: Concern over concentrated corporate wealth and monopoly and proposals for federal supervision or regulation of interstate business.

fine_topics.name: Neutral Rights & Maritime Depredations
fine_topics.definition: Protests against violations of American neutral commerce and the impressment of seamen by European belligerents during the era of the Napoleonic wars.
